verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a sandbox platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting. Network firewall limits and sandbox isolation are separate controls and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
